: Participation reward, pure heart and clear nature (: Participation reward, pure heart and clear nature (page 22) Jiang Lan heard this and looked Shen Qinghan up and down. He was not interested in his thoughts, but looking at Shen Qinghan's behavior, it seemed that he really needed some medicine. Just when he was about to speak, the words on the Prison God Monument suddenly jumped in his mind. Jiang Lan's heart skipped a beat. The next moment, there was a cool breath. , spread out from the depths of Jiang Lan's sea of consciousness. It felt like drinking a bottle of iced Coke in the middle of summer. It was cool and refreshing. Although it was a Sprite advertisement, it was not a big deal. The cool breath swirled in his mind and then flowed down the river. The next moment, Jiang Lan felt that the surrounding environment was much clearer. Shen Qinghan was surprised. This thing is great. Shen Qinghan saw Jiang Lan suddenly stopped talking and asked: "What's wrong?" Jiang Lan came back to his senses. "It's okay. I'm thinking about how to spend the money." Shen Qinghan: "..." How can a person keep jumping between reliability and unreliability? "Be careful...don't spend too much." "Don't worry." Jiang Lan waved his hand, "I will definitely spend the money." "Then the question is, Lady Saint, where is that place?" "Liuye Lane, the third room from the east entrance, the key is buried under the tree in front of the door." Jiang Lan gave a thumbs up. He also put the key under the door of his house. "I will go there later." Shen Qinghan frowned: "Didn't Wang Hu just say that you won't be allowed to leave?" "That's wrong." Lan said seriously, "Leave, you have to find out before you know I left. If no one finds out, won't I be here all the time?" Shen Qinghan: "..." "If you are found out, you will be in trouble." "Actually, I still think it would be more troublesome to starve to death, what do you think?" Shen Qinghan was speechless. Jiang Lan turned around and glanced around the cells. "Stomach cutting! Everyone is looking at me. "Come on!" "I'm stupid... No, I'm cheating." "I'll go out soon. You can guess the consequences. Of course, if you cooperate, I won't be able to improve the food for you." All the prisoners said excitedly: "It's true." Counting Shen Qinghan, there are only thirteen. Thirty taels of silver. It's more than enough to make a meal for them. Moreover, each of these people can squeeze out a lot of oil and water. So, take your time. At this time, Shen Qinghan said again: "If there is someone in the house, don't do anything." Jiang Lan looked at Shen Qinghan and heard her continue: "It may be someone I have arranged for." "No problem." Shen Qinghan paused and added: "If it's someone from the Demon Suppression Division, Don't do anything to the person." Jiang Lan twitched his lips and said, "I said I was a fool, but I'm not really a fool." If there was someone from the Demon Suppression Division, he would definitely turn around and leave. He would still be able to tell the difference between a full meal and a full meal. Of course, the specific situation will depend on the situation at that time. You can't really be so unlucky that you meet someone you shouldn't meet as soon as you go out, right?
